decision_reason: This is a clearly identified NIST Julia scientific package implementing the Bote–Salvat electron-impact ionization cross-section model. Hold because the owner archived the repository in June 2026 and the last substantive source activity is over 48 months old; the static NIST package pages do not establish current use/source parity, and the external thesis citation found is bibliographic only.
